full_judgment: 2. The relevant facts necessary for the disposal of this civil appeal are that the predecessor of the respondents No.1-6 as petitioners filed Miscellaneous Case No.1 of 1996 in the Court of the Assistant Judge, Bochagonj, Dinajpur against the predecessor of the appellants along with others as opposite parties under Section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 (shortly SAT Act) for pre-emption in respect of the schedule land as appended to the petition. The petitioner's case, in a nutshell, is that the pre-emptor was the co-sharer tenant in the case holding and the pre-emptees No.1 and 2 were the strangers to the case holding. The other co-sharer tenants of the case holding, namely pre-emptees No.3 and 4 sold out the case land to the pre-emptees No.1 and 2 by two registered Kabalas No.4405 and 4406 dated 7-9-1995 without serving any notice of the transfer upon the pre-emptor and the pre-emptor came to know about the aforesaid transfer on 28-12-1995. Thereafter, on obtaining the certified copies of the Kabalas the pre-emptor filed the Miscellaneous Case for pre-emption on 12-2-1996.
